trap-rhetorical-pivot.notes: PROPOSED (structural; do not fix inline, the premise is false): RECOMPUTED — the premise is wrong. S is identified from the cited probe's hardcoded S_TARGET as S(mu)=+0.00968298, S(p)=-0.03945936, which recompute exactly as c3 + Vol(4_1) (c3(mu)=-2.0202002328, c3(p)=-2.0693425728, Vol(4_1)=2.0298832128). S is thus a deterministic REAL function of q that changes sign between two REAL q_0, so it HAS a real root — and the sibling block rem-qstar-decay-sector-q0.md, which uses this one, root-finds it: q* = 1.1099785930315233, 80.28% of the way from the proton to the muon anchor. A real q_0 therefore CAN flip the sign of S. Replace with: S has a real zero q* strictly between the anchors, so the sign flip needs no Im(q); the extraction bounds the SIZE of an Im(q) that would reproduce S under the u = 2 log q map, nothing more. Related: 'the input is the measured S' — S is not measured, it is c3 (extracted from measured Q_beta via the 1/u^3 ladder) plus the CHOSEN offset Vol(4_1), a defined residual whose c3^even = -Vol(4_1) identification was retracted (docs/audits/2026-08-08-hh1-outer-class-bar-parity-prune-does-not-exist.md); and the flip is generic, any constant in a 0.0491-wide window producing one. eps values themselves verify: +0.0148679 (+1.339%) and -0.0605885 (-5.459%).
